title: Unit Event — And Now, I Wear This Ribbon — Episode7 Our First Collaborative Work

meta.Event: And Now, I Wear This Ribbon
meta.Event Outline: Noticing how Mafuyu feels more at home surrounded by N25 puts a smile on Mizuki's face. Realizing how they're both alike in that sense, Mizuki recalls their former self before joining N25.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <In terms of a workflow, I was thinking that I'd take your illustrations, Enanan, and turn them into a video. How does that sound?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Then, let's go with that.
Oh, however, I won't have much to do while I wait for you to complete your illustrations, so...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Would it be alright if I asked you to draw me a rough draft first? It should help me figure out what kind of video I want to make.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Like some sketches?
Yes, I can do that.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, but we can always work together if you ever need any help! It's nice to sort of have free reign, but I'm the sort of person that needs some structure.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Hehe. I really appreciate it.
Fortunately, I have a good idea of what I want to draw, so I should be able to get a rough draft to you in fairly short order.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Then, let me know once it's finished. In the meantime, I'll listen to that song again and try coming up with some ideas.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Okay, I'll do that!
For now, I'll be muting myself while I work.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Okay...
That clears up how we're actually gonna work together.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(This feels kinda strange...
I'm so used to making videos by myself.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But I should brainstorm while I wait for her to send me that rough draft...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (This pain and suffering... You get such a clear picture... It's like K and Yuki have actually been to the depths of despair...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's like when you're unable to talk because you're in so much pain...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: This mix of turbulence and silence really sticks out in my mind...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How do I turn that into a video...? Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Huh? Already...?
Oh, I need to unmute myself.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That was fast.
I wasn't expecting you to have it ready so soon.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I think I have K's song to thank for that. I usually end up hitting a wall and have a hard time coming up with ideas... Oh, I'll send it over now.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(What did she draw this time...?
I can't help but have high hopes since her last illustration was so good.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It's a drawing of a girl screaming...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(So this is her interpretation...
It's pretty different from what I had in mind...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(But I really like it...
You can tell exactly what she's saying.)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<How is it...?
Is there anything that concerns you...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No, not at all!
I think it's a really great drawing.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'd like to take what you drew and start thinking about how to turn it into a video, so you can keep working on what you have.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay, I can throw in a wipe here for the first verse and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But it doesn't really go well with the second verse... How do I deal with that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Maybe some different effects?
That might change the feel...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I could try an effect where the screaming girl gets filled in black...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
No, that won't work...
On one hand, I can try out some different things, but on the other, that might make it harder for me to tie this part into the chorus...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Why don't I feel as motivated as last time? Before, I was able to charge on ahead without even thinking about getting permission to use someone else's art...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Maybe I should ask Enanan...
But she's probably hard at work drawing right now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Everything I believed, felt and wanted to do...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yes, I'm here. Can I help you?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <It's just... I noticed that you paused for a moment when you took your first glance at it.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<And I began to wonder...
Is something about my drawing bothering you?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <It's sort of easy for me to tell because I've been drawing since I was little. Based on your reaction, you seemed...confused...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Initially, I thought I was overreacting...
But I gave it some time and realized that I probably wasn't...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I was... Um...
I wasn't confused per se...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I really don't know anything about art...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<That's perfectly fine.
I just want to hear about what you felt when you saw my drawing, Amia.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I mean, if something about it really is bothering you, can't you just tell me?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Yes, I really hate it when someone says that my art's garbage...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But I hate it even more when people treat me with kid gloves and tip-toe around everything!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If she's willing to say that, then I should probably just honestly tell her what I felt...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Although, there's no guarantee that she'll understand my interpretation of this song...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Every so often, I'd meet people who understand the pain I feel...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But something seemed odd about how this girl's screaming.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, when I listened to this song...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I felt this terrible pain. The kind of pain that keeps you even from screaming...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <The kind of pain that keeps you from screaming...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, instead of having a girl shouting, I think it might be better to make it look like she's trying to smile even though she really isn't in the mood to...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I'm not sure I get what you mean...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Sorry, let's forget what I just said.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Why did you feel that way, Amia?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I mean, when you feel emotional pain, you suffer physically too, right...?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <This absolute unbearable amount of pain that you feel and want to do something about... But you can't, so you have no other choice but to scream.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <That was my interpretation of why this song felt so turbulent.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I definitely understand what you mean by that...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Because there was a time when I also felt that pain...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Each time someone hurt me, I'd always ask myself, “Why me?” I was shouting that within my heart...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I have a feeling that Enanan bears some similar scars...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But I believe it's possible to be stricken with so much pain that you can't even scream.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <After feeling an incredible amount of pain for a really long time, there comes a point where you stop caring about anything.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And you try to do something fun to forget about that pain... But it doesn't go away...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <How would anyone have the energy to scream at that point...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Oh...
I might've taken that a little too far...)

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Doing something fun to forget about that pain, huh...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I-I'm sorry...
That was all just my opinion...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <I think I know what you mean...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But let me ask you this. How did you interpret this really turbulent melody? I thought it was about wanting to scream or shout out.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, um...
I saw that as a violent storm raging inside your heart.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Even though there's something you want to scream, you don't because you feel that no one will get it.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<And yet, it lingers and persists...
Because it's what you truly feel.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<...
I see. I never would've seen it that way...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But I think I understand what you saw now... I would've drawn something fairly different if I had earlier...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, even though Enanan and I didn't interpret this song the same way, I understood her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Still... What is this I'm feeling...?
Enanan and I felt different things, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We both arrived at different interpretations, but neither is necessarily right or wrong.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We led different lives until this point, so it's only natural for us to interpret the songs K makes with that person in different ways.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (At the same time... I get the feeling that Enanan went through a really tough time like I did...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <What if we tried to express what we both felt? You know, together...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yes, um... I can make this music video by using your art to show what's happening during the song while animating the lyrics and stuff...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm guessing that we both felt a complex mix of emotions after listening to K's song, and even discovered some new feelings...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<It's hard for me to describe...
But I have a feeling that the music video isn't gonna turn out very well unless we get on the same page.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <By putting our heads together and talking things out like this, we should be able to come up with some good ideas.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I agree...
For K's sake, we've gotta make this video a good one...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm sorry. I just realized that I stopped being formal there for a second.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Oh, me too...
Actually, this might be easier, you know?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, are we good in terms of our theme?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<A silent scream, right...?
Yeah, I think I can work with that.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But I'm gonna have to change her expression and everything since she's just letting everything out into the open right now...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah... I hate to ask you this, but would you mind drawing it again?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Okay.
Also, you don't have to feel bad...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <There's nothing wrong with asking for a redo if it means the final product is gonna look better, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, there's something else that we should talk about before you get back to drawing...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <How we're actually going to present the pain this girl's feeling as she screams in silence.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Of course, we can use your first sketch for that, Enanan... But videos allow you to animate things, so I was thinking that we could give her more of a backstory...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Yeah, that does sound like a good idea...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <When we were discussing our interpretations just now, Amia, I realized that you probably weren't feeling the same things as me...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <But I'm also starting to think that our feelings share the same root. Like something we each care about is being rejected by others...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <So, if we can represent that visually, then I feel like the end result will make a lot more sense. In terms of motifs...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<I know...!
What if we made it so this girl's holding a box?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Yeah. It'll represent what she cares about most.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <While others will try to take it away from her, smash it to pieces or call it worthless.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, I see...!
And the viewer gets to decide what's inside!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That's an awesome idea!
And people who've experienced the same sort of rejection will immediately understand... Oh, wait...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, um... Just a small suggestion... Can we give this box a nice ribbon with a bow?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. This box is supposed to be extremely precious to her, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And wouldn't a ribbon make it a little cuter...?>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Alright, so... I'll draw another sketch... But do you think we should discuss beforehand how the animation's gonna look?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I can try coming up with a storyboard based on your sketch, and you can complete your illustration after that...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line:
<Right...
Then, let's give that a try.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Thanks.
I'm looking forward to seeing your next sketch.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If our music video is gonna do the pain and kindness from K's song justice...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Sister's Voice
rows.Line: Hm...? The door to Mizuki's room is open...

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <I wasn't expecting to see anything like this...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<I think it's incredible...
The last one was also good, but this one really blew me away.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No, Enanan, you deserve the credit!
Thanks for doing all those redraws!>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Hehe.
You two seem so close now.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Oh, um... That sort of just happened on its own as we worked...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Speaking of which, is there anything you'd like for us to fix? It shouldn't be too hard to adjust the coloring and such...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<No, that's okay.
This music video... It's a clear expression of everything that you both felt after hearing our song...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Right...
So, there's actually something else that I'd like to discuss with you...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Would you like to keep making these with us?>
